headers.//: Headers match the requested path, not the rewritten one, and a browser asks for "/" rather than "/index.html". So everything is no-cache by default and the things that can safely be kept opt back out below.
Bundles carry a content hash in the filename, so a given URL can never change its contents. Cache them for a year.

Artwork has no hash in its name, so it cannot be cached forever — replacing a logo would never reach anybody. A day of hard caching with a week of serving the old one while a new one is fetched behind it: repeat visits cost nothing, and a change still lands within a day.
